"""Normalize the archived spans without refitting or accessing evaluation rows."""

import hashlib
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import torch
from safetensors.torch import load, save


def normalize(original, canonical):
    reference = original.read_bytes()
    basis = load(reference)
    normalized, results = {}, {}
    for name, matrix in basis.items():
        seed = matrix.double()
        orthogonal, triangular = torch.linalg.qr(seed, mode="reduced")
        signs = torch.diagonal(triangular).sign()
        assert bool(signs.ne(0).all())
        saved = (orthogonal * signs).float().contiguous()
        result = saved.double()
        gram_error = float((result.T @ result - torch.eye(result.shape[1], dtype=torch.float64)).abs().max())
        error = float((seed - result @ (result.T @ seed)).norm() / seed.norm())
        assert gram_error <= 1e-5 and error <= 1e-6
        normalized[name] = saved
        results[name] = {"gram_max_error": gram_error, "relative_span_error": error}
    payload = save(dict(sorted(normalized.items())))
    with canonical.open("xb") as stream:
        stream.write(payload)
    return {"source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(reference).hexdigest(),
            "canonical_sha256": hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(), "checks": results,
            "method": "FP64 reduced QR with positive diagonal, then FP32 storage"}


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if not __debug__:
        raise RuntimeError("The basis audit requires Python assertions.")
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    original, canonical, destination = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
    record = normalize(original, canonical)
    with destination.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(record, stream, sort_keys=True, indent=2)
        stream.write("\n")

"""Audit the held-out trace screen against its sealed inputs and frozen factors."""

import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import math
import statistics
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import torch
from safetensors.torch import load

from audit_sampler_score import read
from publish_sampler_score import terminal_receipt


def inspect(archive, evidence, factor_path):
    packed = archive.read_bytes()
    recorded = read(evidence)
    factors = factor_path.read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(packed).hexdigest() == recorded["archive_sha256"]
    assert hashlib.sha256(factors).hexdigest() == recorded["basis_artifact_sha256"]
    rank = recorded["rank_per_side"]
    assert rank == 32 and recorded["replayed_completions"] == 32
    identity = torch.eye(rank, dtype=torch.float64)
    matrices = load(factors)
    assert set(matrices) == {"input", "feedback"}
    widths = (8960, 1536)
    orthogonal_error = {}
    eigenvalues = {}
    for index, (name, width) in enumerate(zip(("input", "feedback"), widths, strict=True)):
        matrix = matrices[name]
        assert torch.isfinite(matrix).all() and tuple(matrix.shape) == (width, rank) and matrix.dtype == torch.float32
        assert hashlib.sha256(matrix.numpy().tobytes()).hexdigest() == recorded["basis_sha256"][index]
        precision = matrix.double()
        gram = precision.T @ precision
        orthogonal_error[name] = float((gram - identity).abs().max())
        spectrum = torch.linalg.eigvalsh(gram)
        eigenvalues[name] = [float(spectrum[0]), float(spectrum[-1])]
        assert 0 < eigenvalues[name][0] <= eigenvalues[name][1]
    smallest_scale = math.prod(bounds[0] for bounds in eigenvalues.values())
    largest_scale = math.prod(bounds[1] for bounds in eigenvalues.values())
    assert recorded["basis_bytes"] == rank * sum(widths) * 4
    assert recorded["sketch_bytes_per_token"] == rank * 2 * 4
    assert recorded["exact_bytes_per_token"] == sum(widths) * 4
    packing = json.loads(gzip.decompress(packed))["trial"]["confirmation"]["L1"][8:]
    assert recorded["calibration_ids"] == [row["id"] for row in packing[:4]]
    assert recorded["calibration_tokens"] == sum(sum(row["lengths"]) for row in packing[:4])
    mixed, successes, tested = 0, 0, 0
    retention_bounds = {}
    for report, source in zip(recorded["held_out"], packing[4:], strict=True):
        assert report["id"] == source["id"] and report["rewards"] == source["rewards"]
        assert report["scored_tokens"] == sum(source["lengths"])
        tested += report["scored_tokens"]
        assert report["mixed"] == (0 < sum(report["rewards"]) < 4)
        if report["mixed"]:
            mixed += 1
            learned = report["learned_fraction"]
            control = report["random_fraction"]
            rotated = report["shuffled_alignment"]
            assert all(math.isfinite(value) for value in (learned, control, rotated))
            assert 0 <= learned <= 1.0001 and 0 <= control <= 1.0001
            assert 0 < report["exact_gradient_norm"] and 0 <= report["coordinate_relative_error"] <= 1e-4
            qualified = learned >= 0.25 and learned > max(0, control, rotated)
            assert report["passed"] == qualified
            lower, upper = learned / largest_scale, learned / smallest_scale
            # Gram conditioning bounds the orthogonal projection onto the existing spans.
            # A pass needs a lower bound above the registered gradient-retention floor.
            if qualified:
                assert lower >= 0.25 and lower > control
            retention_bounds[report["id"]] = [lower, upper]
            successes += int(qualified)
            method = report["post_reward_update_ms"]
            assert set(method) == {"exact_dense", "compressed_coordinates", "compressed_dense"}
            for timer in method.values():
                assert len(timer["samples"]) == 5 and all(elapsed > 0 for elapsed in timer["samples"])
                assert statistics.median(timer["samples"]) == timer["median"]
    verify = mixed >= 2 and successes == mixed
    assert recorded["passed"] == verify
    return {"orthogonality_max_error": orthogonal_error, "orthogonality_guard_passed": all(
                error <= 1e-5 for error in orthogonal_error.values()),
            "gram_eigenvalue_extrema": eigenvalues, "orthogonal_retention_bounds": retention_bounds,
            "held_out_questions": len(packing[4:]),
            "held_out_tokens": tested, "mixed_groups": mixed, "qualified_groups": successes, "passed": verify}


def publish(work, registration, digest, output):
    archive = work / "ladder.json.gz"
    raw = work / "compression.json"
    audit_path = work / "compression_audit.json"
    assert inspect(archive, raw, work / "compression.safetensors") == read(audit_path)
    report = read(raw)
    roots = ["compress_sampler_trace.py", "audit_trace_compression.py", "audit_trace_compression_first.py"]
    scripts = {name: {"sha256": hashlib.sha256((work / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                      "content": (work / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8")} for name in roots}
    assert scripts["compress_sampler_trace.py"]["sha256"] == digest
    receipts = {name: terminal_receipt(work / (name + ".json")) for name in
                ("qwen-heldout-trace-compression", "qwen-heldout-compression-bounds")}
    prior_audit_path = work / "qwen-heldout-compression-audit.json"
    prior_audit = read(prior_audit_path)
    assert prior_audit["status"] == "failure"
    assert "orthogonal_error[name] <= 1e-5" in prior_audit["details"]["checks"][0]["output_preview"]
    report.update({"registered_protocol": registration, "sampler_registration": "f20347852127b2ff9230d28428606066b3c3bf69",
                   "audit": read(audit_path), "sources": scripts, "dsr": receipts,
                   "orthogonality_audit_failure": {"run_id": prior_audit["run_id"], "status": prior_audit["status"],
                                                   "receipt_sha256": hashlib.sha256(prior_audit_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}})
    with output.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(report, stream, sort_keys=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if not __debug__:
        raise RuntimeError("The compression audit requires Python assertions.")
    if sys.argv[1] == "publish":
        publish(Path(sys.argv[2]), sys.argv[3], sys.argv[4], Path(sys.argv[5]))
    else:
        prior, raw_evidence, frozen_basis, result = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
        verified = inspect(prior, raw_evidence, frozen_basis)
        with result.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            json.dump(verified, stream, sort_keys=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
            stream.write("\n")

compress_sampler_trace.py.content:
"""Measure held-out gradient retention by a fixed two-sided Qwen score sketch."""

import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import statistics
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import torch
from rich.console import Console
from safetensors.torch import save
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer

from ladder_audit import fingerprint
from qwen_external import LFS_SHA, verify
from sampler_score import analytical_feedback, generate


RANK = 32
CALIBRATION_SEED = 811027
CONTROL_SEED = 811028
CHUNK = 64
ROUNDS = 5


def capture_batch(model, tokenizer, questions, observations):
    block = model.model.layers[-1]
    inputs, residuals = [], []

    def capture_inputs(_module, args):
        inputs.append(args[0][:, -1].clone())

    def capture_residuals(_module, _inputs, output):
        residuals.append(output[:, -1].clone())

    leases = [block.mlp.down_proj.register_forward_pre_hook(capture_inputs),
              block.register_forward_hook(capture_residuals)]
    seed = observations[0]["batch_seed"]
    assert all(row["batch_seed"] == seed for row in observations)
    try:
        encoded, generated, _, _, _ = generate(model, tokenizer, questions, seed, 0)
    finally:
        for lease in leases:
            lease.remove()
    eos = model.generation_config.eos_token_id
    stops = set(eos if isinstance(eos, list) else [eos]) | {tokenizer.pad_token_id}
    tails = generated.sequences[:, encoded.input_ids.shape[1]:].tolist()
    trimmed = [row[:next((index for index, value in enumerate(row) if value in stops), len(row))] for row in tails]
    assert len(trimmed) == 32 and len(inputs) == len(residuals) == len(generated.scores)
    for index, archived in enumerate(observations):
        prefix = encoded.input_ids[index][encoded.attention_mask[index].bool()].tolist()
        assert [prefix + row for row in trimmed[4 * index:4 * index + 4]] == archived["tokens"]
    return indexed_groups(model, inputs, residuals, generated.scores, observations, trimmed)


def indexed_groups(model, inputs, residuals, scores, observations, trimmed):
    groups = []
    for slot, group in enumerate(observations):
        positions = [(4 * slot + sample, step, token) for sample in range(4)
                     for step, token in enumerate(trimmed[4 * slot + sample])]
        device = model.device
        x = torch.stack([inputs[step][row] for row, step, _ in positions]).float()
        norm, head = model.model.norm, model.lm_head.weight.detach()
        pieces = []
        for first in range(0, len(positions), CHUNK):
            window = positions[first:first + CHUNK]
            masked = torch.stack([scores[step][row] for row, step, _ in window])
            count = masked.isfinite().sum(-1)
            assert int(count.min()) >= 50
            value, ids = masked.topk(int(count.max()), dim=-1)
            actions = torch.tensor([token for _, _, token in window], device=device)
            action_mask = (ids == actions[:, None]) & value.isfinite()
            assert bool((action_mask.sum(-1) == 1).all())
            columns = action_mask.to(torch.long).argmax(-1)
            r = torch.stack([residuals[step][row] for row, step, _ in window]).float()
            pieces.append(analytical_feedback(r, norm.weight.detach().float(), norm.variance_epsilon,
                                              head[ids].float(), value, columns))
        source = torch.tensor([row % 4 for row, _, _ in positions], device=device)
        groups.append((group, x, torch.cat(pieces), source))
    return groups


def basis(groups):
    torch.manual_seed(CALIBRATION_SEED)
    torch.cuda.manual_seed(CALIBRATION_SEED)
    active = torch.cat([group[1] for group in groups])
    feedback = torch.cat([group[2] for group in groups])
    estimate = [torch.pca_lowrank(values, q=RANK + 16, center=False, niter=2)[2][:, :RANK].contiguous()
                for values in (active, feedback)]
    torch.manual_seed(CONTROL_SEED)
    torch.cuda.manual_seed(CONTROL_SEED)
    random = [torch.linalg.qr(torch.randn(matrix.shape, device=matrix.device), mode="reduced").Q.contiguous()
              for matrix in estimate]
    return estimate, random, len(active)


def dot(left, right):
    return (left * right).sum()


def time_updates(exact, coordinates, dense):
    names = {"exact_dense": exact, "compressed_coordinates": coordinates, "compressed_dense": dense}
    durations = {name: [] for name in names}
    order = list(names)
    for operation in names.values():
        for _ in range(2):
            operation()
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    for index in range(ROUNDS):
        for offset in range(len(order)):
            name = order[(index + offset) % len(order)]
            torch.cuda.synchronize()
            begin = time.perf_counter_ns()
            names[name]()
            torch.cuda.synchronize()
            durations[name].append((time.perf_counter_ns() - begin) / 1e6)
    return {name: {"samples": samples, "median": statistics.median(samples)} for name, samples in durations.items()}


def score(group, learned, random):
    info, x, f, source = group
    values = torch.tensor(info["rewards"], dtype=torch.float32, device=x.device)
    weights = (values - values.mean())[source]
    denominator = len(weights)
    left, right = learned
    low_x, low_f = x @ left, f @ right
    if not bool(weights.ne(0).any()):
        assert bool((low_f * weights[:, None] == 0).all())
        return {"id": info["id"], "rewards": info["rewards"], "scored_tokens": denominator, "mixed": False}
    exact = x.T @ (f * weights[:, None]) / denominator
    magnitude = float(exact.square().sum())
    assert magnitude > 0

    def sketch(a, b, coefficient):
        return a.T @ (b * coefficient[:, None]) / denominator

    coordinates = sketch(low_x, low_f, weights)
    expected_coordinates = left.T @ exact @ right
    relative = float((coordinates - expected_coordinates).norm()) / float(expected_coordinates.norm())
    assert relative <= 1e-4
    randomized = sketch(x @ random[0], f @ random[1], weights)
    shuffled_reward = values.roll(1)
    shuffled = sketch(low_x, low_f, (shuffled_reward - shuffled_reward.mean())[source])
    learned_fraction = float(coordinates.square().sum()) / magnitude
    shuffle_alignment = float(dot(expected_coordinates, shuffled)) / magnitude
    random_fraction = float(randomized.square().sum()) / magnitude
    timers = time_updates(
        lambda: x.T @ (f * weights[:, None]) / denominator,
        lambda: sketch(low_x, low_f, weights),
        lambda: left @ sketch(low_x, low_f, weights) @ right.T,
    )
    return {"id": info["id"], "rewards": info["rewards"], "mixed": True, "scored_tokens": denominator,
            "exact_gradient_norm": magnitude ** 0.5, "learned_fraction": learned_fraction,
            "random_fraction": random_fraction, "shuffled_alignment": shuffle_alignment,
            "coordinate_relative_error": relative, "post_reward_update_ms": timers,
            "passed": learned_fraction >= 0.25 and learned_fraction > random_fraction
            and learned_fraction > shuffle_alignment and learned_fraction > 0}


def main(checkpoint, manifest, archive, archive_sha, output):
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("highest")
    assert fingerprint(archive) == archive_sha
    sealed = json.loads(gzip.decompress(archive.read_bytes()))
    assert sealed["trial"]["checkpoint_sha256"] == LFS_SHA and sealed["frozen_qualified_setting"]["level"] == "L1"
    verify(checkpoint, manifest)
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(checkpoint, local_files_only=True, trust_remote_code=False)
    tokenizer.padding_side = "left"
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(checkpoint, dtype=torch.bfloat16, local_files_only=True,
                                                trust_remote_code=False, use_safetensors=True).to("cuda").eval()
    model.requires_grad_(False)
    questions = sealed["panels"]["panels"]["confirmation"]["L1"][8:]
    observations = sealed["trial"]["confirmation"]["L1"][8:]
    assert len(questions) == len(observations) == 8 and all(row["family"] == "packing" for row in questions)
    groups = capture_batch(model, tokenizer, questions, observations)
    fitted, random, tokens = basis(groups[:4])
    factors = save({"input": fitted[0].cpu(), "feedback": fitted[1].cpu()})
    with output.with_suffix(".safetensors").open("xb") as stream:
        stream.write(factors)
    assessed = [score(group, fitted, random) for group in groups[4:]]
    mixed = [row for row in assessed if row["mixed"]]
    passed = len(mixed) >= 2 and all(item["passed"] for item in mixed)
    basis_sha = [hashlib.sha256(matrix.cpu().numpy().tobytes()).hexdigest() for matrix in fitted]
    report = {"archive_sha256": archive_sha, "basis_sha256": basis_sha,
              "basis_artifact_sha256": hashlib.sha256(factors).hexdigest(), "rank_per_side": RANK,
              "calibration_ids": [row[0]["id"] for row in groups[:4]], "calibration_tokens": tokens,
              "held_out": assessed, "passed": passed, "replayed_completions": 32,
              "exact_bytes_per_token": 4 * (8960 + 1536), "sketch_bytes_per_token": 4 * (2 * RANK),
              "basis_bytes": 4 * RANK * (8960 + 1536), "device": torch.cuda.get_device_name()}
    Console().print({"passed": passed, "mixed": [{key: row[key] for key
                     in ("id", "learned_fraction", "random_fraction", "shuffled_alignment")} for row in mixed]})
    with output.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(report, stream, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False, indent=2)
        stream.write("\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if not __debug__:
        raise RuntimeError("The compression screen requires Python assertions.")
    main(Path(sys.argv[1]), Path(sys.argv[2]), Path(sys.argv[3]), sys.argv[4], Path(sys.argv[5]))
